plan.model: Shrinkage diagonal Gaussian; 50% covariance shrinkage, fixed
plan.validation: Last three years of historically generated out-of-fold scores, only labels mature by selection time
plan.fallback: threshold0.10; price/crossing for live selector if no adequately supported validation
plan.training: Annual expanding fit on mature-frontier samples; feature standardization on training only
plan.negative_label_policy: Window ends no later than latest pivot mature at training cutoff
plan.warning: All candidates and thresholds are research attempts, including failures. Historical scores are not future evidence.

limits: Historical data repeatedly inspected, not a blind test
Only 3 validation pivots are required: weak calibration evidence, counts disclosed
Historical release timestamps and index constituent history not certified
Scores are not independently calibrated probabilities
The original-rule control predates 2014 whereas probability ledgers begin 2014; evaluation begins2016 and retains actual candidate states
No future pivot counts used as live alarm budgets
